recommendation: Keep the commit as the FHIR-48861 source correction. Further work is only needed if the work group wants the generic RequestStatus vocabulary to add separate stopped/cancelled codes rather than continuing to use revoked for non-completed termination.
issue_request: FHIR-48861 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested a new Request pattern status 'ended' meaning the request is no longer to be acted upon, without distinguishing how much action had already occurred, as a parent for terminal request states.
initial_application: Commit 1555ba4c2b1aa996160b4895a4bb9973d210e0b3 added the 'ended' concept to source/request/codesystem-request-status.xml and source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml, nesting completed and revoked under ended. That application left Request.status' spreadsheet short list without 'ended', omitted CodeSystem.hierarchyMeaning despite nested concepts, and left duplicate literal 'ended' text in the request-status worksheet cell.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists request as an active logical pattern, so source/request feeds the current build. Concrete Request resources already show Request status short lists with 'ended | completed | revoked'. FHIR-48862 was approved in the same workflow meeting and provides supporting Request-status guidance, but it is a separate narrative issue. The generic RequestStatus code system uses 'revoked' for non-completed termination, so this reconciliation did not add resource-specific 'stopped' or 'cancelled' codes.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing fix that adds hierarchyMeaning='is-a' to RequestStatus, updates the Request.status spreadsheet short list and explanatory text to include 'ended' with completed/revoked terminal children, and removes stray duplicate 'ended' text from the worksheet cell.
source_changes: source/request/codesystem-request-status.xml: added hierarchyMeaning='is-a' so the nested ended/completed/revoked concepts explicitly carry parent-child semantics.

source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml: added ended to Request.status short text, clarified ended terminal statuses as completed or revoked, and removed duplicate literal ended text from the request-status worksheet cell.

related_jiras.note: Approved in the same workflow meeting and mentions Request status moving to 'ended', but it concerns separate Request pattern guidance about requester control over status changes.
